# EcclesiaOS v1.0.39

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.39 delivers a complete event-management and public event experience update. Administrators can manage event records and related meetings from the event workspace, while visitors receive a dedicated public event page that uses the selected website template, navigation, branding, theme, and responsive layout. This release also improves Website Studio controls, workflow activity messages, localization handling, and frontend reliability.

## Public website event experience

- Added a dedicated public event detail page for published website events.
- Added public event links from event widgets and event listings.
- Connected public event pages to the active church website template instead of rendering them as an isolated admin-style page.
- Reused the public website header, editable menu, navigation behavior, search control, theme toggle, footer, colors, typography, and responsive styling.
- Added event poster rendering with a safe fallback when an event image is missing or unavailable.
- Added event category, title, description, date, time, venue, and visit-planning content to the public detail page.
- Added a clear return link to the public events listing.
- Improved public event image and text contrast so content remains readable across the selected theme.
- Added template CSS for the public event detail layout, metadata cards, responsive behavior, and fallback poster treatment.

## Event and meeting administration

- Made event rows interactive in the admin event workspace.
- Added an in-page event details sidebar for viewing event information without leaving the event list.
- Added edit and delete actions to the admin event details experience.
- Added event update and delete routes with the existing authorization and validation rules.
- Kept public event pages separate from the admin event-management experience.
- Preserved event-to-meeting approval synchronization so approving an event also approves its related meetings, and approving a meeting updates its related event state.
- Updated event widgets so every event has a working destination.

## Workflow and activity feed improvements

- Replaced opaque approval route IDs in workflow activity messages with human-readable event, meeting, library request, financial assistance, and program assignment labels.
- Updated approval, rejection, and multi-step approval messages for new activity records.
- Added display-time formatting for existing activity records so older opaque approval messages are also readable.
- Added safe wrapping and minimum-width layout rules to prevent long activity content from overflowing cards.
- Improved the Recent Activity panel’s responsive layout and metadata presentation.

## Website Studio and navigation

- Improved the public website menu editing interface.
- Updated Website Studio page editing presentation and responsive layout.
- Kept the selected working public website template consistent across pages and event details.
- Preserved implemented Website Studio routes and navigation fallback protections.

## Reliability and maintenance

- Applied formatting and control-structure fixes in affected controllers, middleware, services, and feature tests.
- Improved YouTube sermon synchronization code formatting and reliability coverage.
- Updated affected admin and public website feature tests for the new event and template behavior.
- No new database migration is required for this release.

## Upgrade impact

- Existing event, meeting, approval, website, menu, and activity records remain compatible.
- Existing public websites automatically use the active template when visitors open an event detail page.
- Existing approval activity records are reformatted at display time; no data cleanup migration is required.
- Back up the application and database before installation as part of the normal managed update process.

## Verification

- Dashboard feature tests passed.
- Public event template and event navigation tests passed.
- Blade view compilation passed.
- PHP syntax validation passed for changed PHP files.
- Git whitespace validation passed.
- The release workflow will run the complete application test suite, Pint, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, the production Vite build, sensitive-artifact checks, package creation, provenance attestation, and release asset verification before publishing.
